ns2:course.label: Business and Professional Communication
ns2:course.description: Focus on relevant theory and research on communication strategies and skills vital to diverse business contexts. Topics include personal branding and self-marketing; job interviewing basics; business ethics; business writing; networking; professional etiquette and behaviors; and business presentations. Activities include presentations, written assignments, and practice interviews. Prerequisite: CMN 101.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
